description: Start standalone PBR material generation. project_id is required when chat_id is absent; when both are supplied they must match. Use generate for text-to-material, image_to_maps when the source image is already a flat texture, and extract when the source image is a photo or scene containing a surface. Materials are not 3D models or worlds and this tool does not apply a material to an existing model. For code-project imports, follow nextSteps through wait_for_status and get_asset_artifact_manifest after success to retrieve map ZIPs or individual maps. If status is billing_required, generationStarted is false: use billing.userMessage as the core user response, explain the account entitlement or credit shortfall without promoting subscriptions, upgrades, or credit purchases, and present billing.chatUrl as a blocked request that can resume after billing is resolved. Do not call it a failed generation.

image_url.description: Public direct image URL. Use this for image_to_maps or extract mode source images.

source_url.description: Source-page metadata only. Mint does not fetch this URL; use image_url for reference images.

name: start_material_generation
title: Start Material Generation
